description_en: Modifies the outbound phone number list of a skill group by calling ModifySkillGroupOutboundNumbers
description_zh: 调用ModifySkillGroupOutboundNumbers修改技能组的外呼电话列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-skill-group-outbound-numbers --instance-id 9cfad875-6260-4a53-ab6e-b13e3fb31f7d --skill-group-id c6010943-c0f6-44e5-8f94-60a85a647178 --operation-type 1 --outbound-phone-number-id example-string --api-version 2017-07-05 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySkillGroupOutboundNumbers

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to which the skill group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待编辑技能组所属呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group to modify
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

1: Add. Adds all specified phone numbers to the current outbound phone number list.
2: Delete. Removes all specified phone numbers from the current outbound phone number list.
3: Reset. Clears the current outbound phone number list and adds all specified phone numbers to the list.
Other values are invalid and an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
支持新增、删除、重置。

1 = 新增，把传入的所有号码添加到当前的外呼列表中，
2 = 删除，把传入的所有号码从当前的外呼列表中删除
3 = 重置，把当前外呼号码列表中的号码情况，把传入的所有号码增加到外呼号码列表中。
其他值无效，返回错误
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the outbound phone number to bind to the skill group. 400 numbers do not support outbound calls. Any 400 numbers that are specified are automatically filtered out.

The parameter name OutboundPhoneNumberId.1 indicates that only one outbound phone number is bound. To bind multiple numbers, specify multiple parameters such as OutboundPhoneNumberId.1, OutboundPhoneNumberId.2, and OutboundPhoneNumberId.3
parameters.help_zh:
需要绑定到技能组的外呼号码的号码ID。400号码不支持外呼，传入的400号码，会被自动过滤。

参数名称OutboundPhoneNumberId.1意为只绑定一个外呼号码，如果绑定多个号码，则需要传多个，例如 OutboundPhoneNumberId.1、OutboundPhoneNumberId.2、OutboundPhoneNumberId.3，以此类推
parameters.name: outbound_phone_number_id

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
